description: List the photos and videos you are allowed to see, with what the agent said each shows (summary), taken time, GPS location, heading and camera details. Filter by job, kind, words in the summary or transcript (q), summary status, distance from a point, taken time, or whether it has a location.

has_location.description: Only photos with (true) or without (false) GPS

job_id.description: Only photos on this job. Leave out to search every photo you can see.

near_lat.description: Latitude of a point; with near_lng and radius_m, only photos taken within radius_m of it

q.description: Words to find in what agents said the photo or video shows: summary, readable text such as serial numbers, findings and video transcripts

sort.description: Default uploaded; distance needs near_lat and near_lng

taken_after.description: ISO date or time: photos taken at or after this

taken_before.description: ISO date or time: photos taken before this

name: media_list
